sim.comment: P629 native crowding damage and warnings are on by default. Use off for single-sector stress tests/showcases; out-of-bounds damage remains enabled.

liveSettings.comment: P618 — load-driven EVE-style time dilation. off (default) = only the admin `timescale` cheat / sim.timeScale moves the clock; auto = the server lowers sim.timeScale toward nominal/cost (clamped [0.1,1.0]) when tick cost can't hold real time (e.g. ~390 ships in one sector), easing back as load drops. An admin `timescale` cheat always overrides auto.

discovery.comment: P731 — the UDP 'Find Server' responder. Enabled by default on the game port + 1 (6074 for a 6073 game — the client's well-known probe port). Set discovery.enabled=false to stop advertising. An admin who moves the game port should pin discovery.port to 6074 (or tell players the port) so clients can still find the server. rateLimitPerSecond guards against reflection-amplification storms. The responder answers LAN broadcast/multicast AND unicast (Tailscale/VPN/subnet) queries with name/map/players/version/game port only — no secrets.
